item.title: Can I Use Soaker Hoses on a Balcony?
item.description: Soaker hoses seem like an easy win for balcony gardens. They are cheap, readily available, and promise gentle, even watering. But balconies are not backyards, and container gardens behave differently than in-ground beds. The short answer: yes, you can use soaker hoses on a balcony, but they rarely work as well as drip irrigation for container setups. Here is when soaker hoses make sense, when they disappoint, and how to set them up if you decide they fit your situation.
